subject: Commit clarity mini-sprint: claim or provide evidence for stale opps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: sales-ops@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit clarity mini-sprint: claim or provide evidence for stale opps

Team —

Quick heads up: finance is flagging a ~48k swing in projected commit for the next 6 weeks; a lot of that delta is coming from deals that haven't had stage or close-date verification in >60 days. We need a lightweight, 48-hour mini-sprint to either:

- Claim these opportunities and add the required evidence (PO timeline, contract lane, executive sponsor confirmation), or
- Move them to Shelve/Archive if there's no active motion.

I attached a CSV with the list ("stale-opps-list.csv"). Please:
1) Owners, mark the SFDC record today with updated stage and add a comment with required evidence link.
2) If you need help collecting evidence, ping Monica and Sales Ops — they can coordinate the template and verification.
3) If there's an active executive review or procurement hold, reply with a one-line status and ETA.

I'll run a reconciliation pass tomorrow afternoon and escalate anything unclaimed to managers. Short, sharp, and no heavy process — just the minimum for close/commit accuracy.

Thanks,
Vanessa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stale-opps-list.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit clarity mini-sprint: claim or provide evidence for stale opps

Got it — thanks for pulling this together. I'm owner on three in the export: 
- STEL-4721 (Stellar Health) — procurement asked for updated SOW and expected PO in mid-April; I have a call set for 3/19 with Will Turner to confirm timeline.
- ACME-3310 — no recent contact, will attempt re-engage today; will update stage to "Contracting" only if I get confirmation.
- NEXA-2200 — product/legal scoping in progress; marking as "Commit" with evidence link once legal confirms.

I'll update SFDC with notes and add the evidence to the template folder. If anything changes, I'll flag in this thread.

—Ben
Senior Account Exec

Subject: Re: Commit clarity mini-sprint: claim or provide evidence for stale opps

Appreciate the nudge — I'll coordinate with Sales Ops to make the evidence collection frictionless. Two ask items from my side:

1) Owners: add the exact doc link or screenshot in the SFDC "Commit Evidence" field. A single sentence in the record is enough (e.g., "PO expected 4/15 — confirm on 3/19 with Will").
2) If you cannot reach the customer within 48 hours, set stage to "At Risk" and move close date +30 days; Sales Ops will flag any that need immediate escalation to AE manager.

I will run a verification pass Friday EOD and share a short roll-up for Finance.

—Monica
Director, Customer Success Operations

From: Sales Ops <sales-ops@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit clarity mini-sprint: claim or provide evidence for stale opps

Folks — reconciliation complete: attached is the updated CSV with owner status populated and a short evidence-template.docx to copy/paste into SFDC. Summary:

- 8 deals marked Claim (evidence attached) — total ARR in commit: $31,200
- 2 deals moved to At Risk / +30d — total ARR moved out: $10,500
- 2 deals unresponsive (moved to Shelve) — total ARR shelved: $6,300

Next steps:
- Ben: please confirm STEL-4721 after your 3/19 call and paste the one-line evidence into SFDC.
- Rishi: I left a note on NEXA-2200 for legal confirmation; please update once you have the go-ahead.

Attachments (stub): stale-opps-list.csv (updated), evidence-template.docx (DOCX, 1 file)

If anyone needs Sales Ops to reach out to the customer on your behalf, reply-all with the deal id and we will coordinate.

Thanks — Sales Ops
